description: lockFileMaintenance is how transitive dependencies get updated at all. It has no release timestamp, so Renovate's minimumReleaseAge would keep it pending forever and is "0 days" there; pnpm applies the one in pnpm-workspace.yaml when it regenerates the lockfile.
lockFileMaintenance has its own default schedule, so it repeats the weekly one.

packageRules.description: The library these docs document, exempt from minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml too, so a new release lands right away.
TypeScript 7 ships no JS API yet, and vue-tsc and typescript-eslint run on it.
